name: BigCodeReward
description: BigCodeReward is a benchmark curated from over 4,700 multi-turn code-centric conversation samples with pairwise human preferences, designed to evaluate the consistency between reward models and human preferences in code generation tasks.
reputation: A niche but useful benchmark for evaluating reward models on code-centric preference data, with growing interest in alignment research for code generation.
notes: Collected from human evaluation platform with code execution; includes an automatic Elo rating benchmark (AutoCodeArena) for code quality assessment without human involvement.
